seed: A marquee only takes a piece out of a picture. Drawn over half a rectangle or a piece of text, Command X used to take the WHOLE shape onto the clipboard and Backspace used to do nothing at all, both without a word. Now both refuse and the canvas says which, in one line at the bottom. Cutting a piece out of a real picture is untouched, and so is cutting with no marquee.

steps.note: a rectangle drawn and picked; layers should be 2 (Background + Rectangle)
a marquee over the LEFT HALF of the rectangle, rectangle still picked

THE TEST: Command X must NOT take the rectangle. layers stays 2, canUndo stays false, and copied reads 'Cannot cut a piece out · Only a picture can have a piece taken out. Clear the marquee to cut the whole layer.'
THE TEST: Backspace over the same marquee says 'Cannot delete a piece' instead of doing nothing at all. layers stays 2
NOT FIXED HERE: Option Backspace (fill the marquee) over the same shape. Recorded so the audit can say honestly whether the rest of the family still goes quiet
escape takes the ants down and leaves the rectangle picked
THE CONTROL: with the marquee cleared, Command X takes the whole rectangle as it always did. layers drops to 1
a real picture picked with a marquee over its corner
THE CONTROL: a piece really does come out of a picture. copied must NOT be a refusal, canUndo true
